title: Little Red Riding Hood
style: Watercolor and colored-pencil storybook illustrations; woodland greens, warm cream, and a scarlet cloak; soft morning sunlight outdoors, cool shadows inside the cottage, and warm light after the rescue.
story:
Little Red Riding Hood’s mother tucked bread and a small cake into a wicker basket. “Take these to Grandmother’s cottage, and stay on the forest path.” Red tied her scarlet hood and set off.

Under an oak tree, a wolf stepped onto the path. “Where are you going?” he asked.

“To Grandmother’s cottage beside the three birch trees,” Red replied.

“Why not bring her flowers?” suggested the wolf. While Red picked daisies, he raced ahead.

At the cottage’s green front door, the wolf knocked and called in a sweet voice, “It’s Little Red Riding Hood!”

“Lift the latch,” Grandmother answered from bed.

The wolf rushed inside and swallowed her whole. He put on her nightcap, pulled her quilt over himself, and waited.

Red arrived, pushed open the green door, and placed her basket on the wooden table. She approached the bed.

“Grandmother, what big ears you have!”

“All the better to hear you with.”

“What big eyes you have!”

“All the better to see you with.”

Red gripped her cloak. “What big teeth you have!”

“All the better to eat you with!”

The wolf sprang up. Red screamed, but he swallowed her whole. Then he fell asleep, snoring loudly.

A passing woodcutter heard the snores and entered through the green door. Seeing the wolf’s swollen belly, he carefully snipped it open. Red scrambled out, then helped Grandmother climb free. Trembling with relief, they hugged.

They filled the sleeping wolf’s belly with stones. When he awoke, he stumbled and fell dead.

Grandmother shared the cake with her rescuers. Red promised never to wander from the path again.

assets.name: Little Red Riding Hood
assets.spec: Red is a slender young girl with warm fair skin, round cheeks, a small nose, and large brown eyes. Her dark chestnut hair has a short straight fringe and two braids reaching just below her shoulders. She wears a warm cream calf-length dress, a sage-green apron, cream stockings, and brown ankle boots. Her defining garment is a scarlet knee-length cape with a roomy rounded hood, fastened beneath her chin with two scarlet ties.
assets.height: A small child, about half the height of a grown person.
assets.note: The cape reaches approximately mid-calf rather than knee-length.

assets.name: Red’s mother
assets.spec: Mother has an average build, warm fair skin, an oval face, hazel eyes, and softly arched brown eyebrows. Her chestnut-brown hair is parted in the middle and gathered into a neat low bun. She wears a moss-green long-sleeved dress reaching her ankles, a plain warm cream apron tied at the waist, and dark brown leather shoes.
assets.height: An average-height grown woman, roughly twice Red’s height.

assets.name: Wicker basket
assets.spec: The basket is an open oval wicker basket woven from honey-brown willow strips, with a flat base and gently flaring sides. A thick braided rim surrounds the opening, and one sturdy arched handle runs between the two short ends. It has no lid, lining, ribbon, or decoration.
assets.height: About 35 centimeters wide and 22 centimeters deep, with a handle that allows it to be carried in one hand.
assets.note: The handle attaches to the two long sides rather than running between the two short ends.

assets.name: Grandmother
assets.spec: Grandmother is a slender elderly woman with a gently stooped posture, fair skin, a narrow softly wrinkled face, blue-gray eyes, and a small rounded nose. Her silver-white hair is gathered into a low bun, with a few soft wisps beside her temples. She wears a loose warm cream nightdress with long sleeves and narrow sage-green stitching at the collar and cuffs. Her white cotton nightcap has a rounded gathered crown, a narrow ruffled brim, and two white ties fastened beneath her chin.
assets.height: A short elderly grown woman, about one and a half times Red’s height.
assets.note: The nightdress has additional sage-green trim across the chest yoke and front buttons not specified. The lower hem and feet are cropped out.

assets.name: Wolf
assets.spec: The wolf is a natural four-legged animal with a long lean body, a deep chest, strong legs, large paws, and a thick bushy tail; he normally walks on all fours and wears no clothing. His fur is charcoal gray along the back and tail, medium gray on the flanks, and warm pale gray on the chest, belly, and muzzle. He has tall pointed ears, large amber eyes beneath dark brows, a long tapered muzzle, a black nose, and prominent ivory canine teeth.
assets.height: A large natural wolf, about waist-high to a grown person when standing on all fours.
assets.note: The ivory canine teeth are visible only as small tips rather than being prominent.

assets.name: Grandmother’s quilt
assets.spec: The quilt is a thick rectangular cotton patchwork cover made from equal-sized squares in warm cream, muted sage green, and faded rust red. The squares repeat in a regular alternating pattern, with visible cream quilting stitches forming small diamonds. A solid sage-green binding finishes all four edges, and the underside is plain warm cream.
assets.height: A single-bed quilt, long and wide enough to cover one grown person.
assets.note: The color sequence is not consistently alternating, with adjacent cream squares. Quilting stitches mostly form diagonal crosses rather than small diamonds.

assets.name: Woodcutter
assets.spec: The woodcutter is a broad-shouldered, sturdy man with warm fair skin, a square face, brown eyes, and a short chestnut beard and mustache. His chestnut hair is cropped short and slightly wavy. He wears a moss-green long-sleeved shirt with the sleeves rolled to his forearms, dark brown trousers held by tan suspenders, and heavy dark brown leather boots.
assets.height: A tall grown man, about a head taller than Mother.

places.name: Forest
places.look: Fresh spring woodland surrounds a small weathered timber cottage with pale chinking, a low stone foundation, and a dark shingled roof. Rough oak bark, white birch trunks, moss, and soft grass give the clearing a storybook texture.
places.camera: Adult-eye-height wide view from the near end of the approach path, looking toward the cottage front. Frame the oak on the left, the entire front facade, and all three birches on the right.

places.name: Forest path
places.look: A quiet stretch of compacted woodland earth bordered by moss, sparse grass, and fern-green undergrowth. Slender background trunks and fresh spring leaves create an inviting but enclosed woodland mood.
places.camera: Adult-eye-height wide view from the near end of the path, looking straight toward its far bend. Keep the broad foreground and the right-hand verge visible.
